description: Canonical SMS templates the agents are expected to handle. Each entry has the sender, the body, the expected A1 output (kind/amount/direction/channel/merchant), and the expected A2 merchant name after normalisation. Add a new entry whenever a new bank template is added; the corpus is the long-term regression net for the multi-agent pipeline.
